༄༅/ /'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi skong ba bsdus pa yang rdzong ma bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// "!#'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi skong ba bsdus pa yang rdzong ma bzhugs so//

hūm̐/ rgyal kun yab gcig bcom ldan 'jam dpal dbyangs// drag tu khros pa dpal chen gshin rje'i gshed// 'jigs byed khrag 'thung phyag rgya zil gyis gnon// dad pa dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren na// 'khor bcas chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la// dur khrod 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// snang ba snod kyi gzhal yas khang pa ru// srid pa bcud kyi mchod rdzas lhun gyis grub// phung khams skye mched lus kyi gzhong pa ru// rang byung dur khrod drag po'i dam rdzas bshams// rtog med mtshan ldan gsang ba'i bam chen la// dgyes skong dam tshig gnyan po yongs su rdzogs// zab gsal chos kyi dbyings kyi snod yangs par// mi 'gyur ye shes rig pa'i bdud rtsis bkang*// snang stong lha rdzas phyi mchod tshar du dngar// gsal stong rang byung nang mchod sprin ltar gtibs// bde stong phyag rgya gsang mchod gar gyis sgeg /dngos 'byor srid zhi'i dpal 'byor mtha' yas shing*// yid sprul kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung gtibs// mnyam nyid lta bas mkha' khyab rol mor spel// 'khor 'das kun khyab rmad byung dam rdzas 'dis// rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*// 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i thugs dam bskang*// bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon thugs dam bskang*// sbyor sgrol dbyings kyi yum chen thugs dam bskang*// gyad gnon chen po brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang*// tshe bdag 'chi bdag srog bdag thugs dam bskang*// gshed chen yab yum bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*// las byed mon pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*// bdud po chen po sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*// zla ba'i 'chi bdag bcu gnyis thugs dam bskang*// zhag gi gshin rje so gnyis thugs dam bskang*// sgo srung dregs pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*// phyi 'khor bdun brgya nyi shu'i thugs dam bskang*// ma mo bye ba sa ya'i thugs dam bskang*// bka' sdod las gshin yab yum thugs dam bskang*// 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// phyag rgya lha bsgoms sku yi thugs dam bskang// phyi yi dam tshig nyams chag sor chud nas// lus la tshe dbang gzi brjid 'bar bar mdzod// rlung sngags bzlas pas gsung gi thugs dam bskang*// nang gi dam tshig nyams chag sor chud nas// ngag la mthu stobs nus pa ldan par mdzod// lta sgom zab mos thugs kyi thugs dam bskang*// gsang ba'i dam tshig nyams chag sor chud nas// yid la rtogs pa'i ye shes 'char bar mdzod// bstan la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs// byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zlog

/bod khams phung byed dam sri rtsad nas choms// snying po'i bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur sgrengs// ye shes spyan gyis dus gsum kun tu gzigs// sgrub po 'khor dang bcas la byin gyis rlobs// mi mthun bdud kyi g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing*// mchog thun dngos grub yid bzhin 'grub mdzad gsol// zhes pa'ang sgrub gnas chen po sbrags kyi yang rdzong gshin rje rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du tshogs 'khor brgya rtsa bgyis pa'i tshe padma gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis yud tsam la shar mar bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
